newsitem.title: USA: York Int'l sees Q2 EPS $0.95 to $1.00.
newsitem.headline: York Int'l sees Q2 EPS $0.95 to $1.00.

text.p: York International Corp said Wednesday it expected to report second-quarter earnings in a range of $0.95 to $1.00 a share.
The forecast compares with earnings of $1.05 a share in the second quarter of 1996.

The company, which makes heating, ventilating, air conditioning and refrigeration products, said the second-quarter results would reflect lower-than-expected sales volume for its unitary products group. Sales were disappointing because of unseasonably cool weather in the United States and weak markets in Europe, it said.
York also said it had sold its German commercial refrigeration contracting business to B.K.T. Bonnet Kaltetechnick GmbH, a unit of EL.FI. Elettrofinanziaria S.p.A. Terms were not disclosed.
The sale will eliminate any further charges related to the downsizing of the German operation, it said.
